data.name: Dark Truth
data.detailed_description: Dark Truth is a horror survival game that comes with a dark story. It has interesting gameplay with puzzles and shooting weapons for attacking zombies and monsters. Also, there are bosses that the player must deal with, and the game contains fruits and drinks for healing includes there are more than 5 weapons and melee weapons. Also, the game includes chapters. Every chapter has a new map and different puzzles and jump scares are creative. Also, in some of the chapters there is an enemy chasing the player. Also, there is a chapter on finding a car part and fix the car for escape. the game is designed by high quality realistic graphics The game is very large, and it took 3 years of development. The game was made by one person. The developer used all of his experience in this project.
